definition.text: written information kept so that it can be looked at later

example.text: Keep a record of everything you spend.
example.translation: 把你的每一笔开支都记下来。

example.text: The doctor checked her medical records.

definition.text: the best result ever achieved in an activity
a flat disc on which music has been stored
the facts known about somebody's past behaviour or performance at work

example.text: The company has a good safety record.

definition.text: a piece of information in a database, stored as a single unit
to store sounds or pictures so that they can be played again

example.text: The band recorded a new album last year.
example.translation: 这支乐队去年录制了一张新专辑。

definition.text: to write down information so that it can be used later

example.text: All sales are recorded in the system.
example.translation: 所有销售都记录在系统里。
